moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-hold-confirm, written here): Outlined button 150x46 r14. While held, the accent fill wipes left to right linearly over 1.2 s (dark label copy inside). Early release at 50 % (hold 0.4-1.0 s): the fill returns to 0 in 250 ms power2.out with a 'released → cancelled' hint (1.0-1.7 s). Second hold from 1.6 s completes at 2.8 s: 'CONFIRMED' with a check popping (back.out 0.22 s). A thin 100x4 bar below mirrors the fill. Fade back 3.55-3.8 s. Params: hold (1.2 s, none) · cancel (0.25 s, power2.out) · presses [[giây bắt đầu, giây thả]] · label.
